record.question: The term 'comfort women' was appeared recently in the news between which countries?
record.explanation: Answer B: Japan and South Korea. The comfort-women issue concerns Japan and South Korea. Japan's own Kono Statement review describes exchanges between Japan and the Republic of Korea; this directly identifies the pair in option B. Historical/source note: Korea here means the Republic of Korea (South Korea); historical 2014 controversy. Reference: https://www.mofa.go.jp/files/100136721.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
